name: Turn meeting transcripts into Monday.com tasks via AI for Property Company

parameters.content:
## Turn Meeting Transcripts into Monday.com Tasks

Automates the full pipeline from Fireflies.ai meeting transcript to structured tasks in Monday.com. When a recording finishes processing, this workflow fetches the transcript, uses Gemini AI to extract all action items with assignees and deadlines, creates each as a Monday.com task, then posts a consolidated summary to Slack — so nothing from a meeting falls through the cracks.

### How it works
- Fireflies sends a POST webhook when a transcript is ready
- Workflow immediately responds 200 OK to Fireflies (prevents retries)
- Fetches meeting title, date, and AI summary from Fireflies GraphQL API
- Gemini AI extracts structured action items: task title, assignee, deadline, priority, notes
- Code node parses the AI JSON output and splits into individual items
- Each action item is created as a task in Monday.com via its GraphQL API
- Final Code node builds a formatted recap message with priority icons
- Slack receives the full meeting summary with all tasks listed

### Setup
1. Add this workflow's production webhook URL in your Fireflies webhook settings.
2. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential for Fireflies (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY) and assign it to the Fetch Transcript node.
3. Connect your Google Gemini (PaLM) API credential to the Gemini model node.
4. In the Workflow Configuration node, set your Monday.com board ID, column IDs (status, date, notes), and Slack channel ID.
5. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential for Monday.com and assign it to the Create Task node.
6. Connect a Slack OAuth2 credential to the Send Summary node, then activate the workflow.

### Customization
- Edit the Gemini prompt to match your task naming conventions or add more output fields
- Add a Switch node after Parse to route tasks to different Monday boards by keyword
- Replace the Slack node with a Telegram or email node if preferred

### Note on Monday.com column IDs
Column IDs differ per board (status, date, text). Check yours via the Monday API or the board's column settings before activating.

## 1. Receive & Acknowledge

Fireflies POSTs here when a recording is ready. Respond 200 immediately so Fireflies does not retry, then fetch the full transcript.

## 2. Fetch & Extract with AI

Fetches title, date, and AI summary from the Fireflies GraphQL API using the meeting_id from the webhook. Gemini then parses the summary into structured action items.

## 3. Create Tasks & Notify

Each action item becomes a task in Monday.com. After all are created, one Slack message summarises the full meeting recap for the team channel.

options.systemMessage: You are a meeting operations assistant for a real estate company. Your only job is to extract action items from meeting transcripts and return them as a clean JSON array. Always return valid JSON only — never include markdown fences, explanations, or any text outside the JSON array.
